queries_run: Mastercard market share gaining OR losing 2026 Visa purchase volume
Mastercard new entrant OR displace threat stablecoin account-to-account 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 列出競爭者含 Visa、AmEx、JCB、銀聯、Discover，並指即時帳戶對帳戶支付系統可能侵蝕 P2M/P2P 份額；部分對手在特定地區份額高於 MA
findings.excerpt: As these real-time account-based propositions mature, we face a possible increase in competition for our existing domestic person-to-merchant (“P2M”) and person-to-person (“P2P”) transaction market share.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：部分客戶與對手有近乎排他關係，且 MA 自這些客戶取得可觀營收，客戶可能將業務轉給對手
findings.excerpt: Furthermore, we earn substantial revenue from customers with nearly-exclusive relationships with our competitors. Such relationships could provide advantages to the customers to shift business from us to the competitors with which they are principally aligned.

findings.claim: Nilson：2025 年美國 Visa 購買量 7.028 兆美元（佔 70.38%），MA 2.958 兆美元、成長 6.3%，略低於 Visa 的 6.8%
findings.source: Nilson Report, Mastercard and Visa cards in the US 2025（經搜尋摘要轉述）

findings.claim: MA 收購 BVNK 並開放結算予穩定幣，穩定幣被視為潛在替代威脅，MA 採參與策略
findings.source: Decrypt: Mastercard Brings Its Fraud-Fighting Tools to Stablecoin Payments
findings.excerpt: Mastercard said Stablecoin Security builds on existing tools like Crypto Credential and Crypto Secure, and that it plans to extend the product’s reach in 2027, including through BVNK.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 未找到 2026 年 MA 對 Visa 的份額拆分；Nilson 日期為推估。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
